title_sq: Ne Ali Dem, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Super Planimetri, Ne Ndertim Te Ri !!!

title_en: In Ali Dem, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with super floor plan, in a new building!!!
description_en: In Ali Dem, on Idriz Dollaku Street, Apartment for sale 2+1+2 toilets in New Building!!! The apartment is located on the 5th residential floor, in a residential and service building with 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 floors and with 2 floors of underground parking. The apartment has South orientation. It has a gross area of ​​110.94 m², a net area of ​​96.27 m². The apartment is organized as follows: distribution corridor, living room where there is a living room and a kitchen with access to the balcony, a matrimonial bedroom with a dedicated toilet, a children's bedroom and a central toilet. The materials that are being used and the new construction technologies, both in the realization of the refinishing and in the realization of the hydro-insulating layers, the realization of the double wall that separates the apartments between them and the outside environment, acoustic insulation, hydraulic equipment of quality brands, quality windows, the multisplit air conditioning system make the quality of the construction to be maximum. The construction is currently in the carbine phase.
